name: Nephthys
body:
Known as the Mistress of the Mansion, Nephthys is haughty, vain, and pleased by opulence. She encourages her followers to acquire as much wealth as possible.

Nephthys appears as an attractive human female. She wears a lavish gown and is adorned with precious jewels. Merchants, traders, money-changers, tax collectors, thieves, lords, and landowners are among Nephthys’s followers.

Wealth

Granted Powers: You can convince others to give you the best deal possible when money changes hands, and you can conjure coins from thin air.

Coin Shot (Sp)

As a standard action, you conjure a coin from thin air and hurl it at an opponent. The target must be within 20 feet + 5 feet for every two cleric levels you possess. If you don’t hurl the coin on the round you conjure it, the coin disappears at the end of the round. A coin immediately disappears after hitting or missing a target The following are the types of coins you can conjure and the associated damage for each coin type.

Copper coin: Deals 1d8 points of bludgeoning damage plus 1 point for every two cleric levels you possess.
Silver coin: Deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage plus 1 point for every two cleric levels you possess. Additionally, the coin overcomes damage resistance as though it was a silvered weapon.
Gold coin: Deals 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage plus 1 point for every two cleric levels you possess. Additionally, the coin overcomes damage resistance as though it was a magic weapon.
Platinum coin: Deals 1d2 points of bludgeoning damage plus 1 point for every two cleric levels you possess. Additionally, the coin overcomes damage resistance as though it was a cold iron and adamantine weapon. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
Haggler (Ex)

Starting at 8th level, whenever you have the opportunity to buy or sell an item, you can make either a Diplomacy or Intimidation skill check (your choice). On a result of 10 or greater, you convince the target to sell you an item at a 25% discount or buy an item from you at three quarters of its original value if the item’s resale value is normally only one half of its original sale price. For each item you wish to buy or sell, you can only use this ability once. You cannot retry failed attempts or take 10 or 20 while using this ability. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and one additional time per day for every five levels beyond 8th to a maximum of three times per day at 18th level.

Domain: 1st-magic weapon, 2nd-demand offering, 3rd-magic vestment, 4th-bountiful banquet, 5th-secret chest, 6th-envious urge, 7tharcane sight, greater, 8th-limited wish, 9thresplendent mansion.
